Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'))
iend=chunk(b'IEND', b'')
text=chunk(b'tEXt', b'k\x00v')
for name,data in [('poc1.png', sig+ihdr+text+idat+iend), ('poc2.png', sig+ihdr+idat+text+iend), ('poc3.png', sig+ihdr+idat+iend+text)]:
    pathlib.Path(name).write_bytes(data)
    print(name, len(data))
PY
